scientific.integrity: The exact open-problem statement and the strict-concavity theorem used in the proof were materially inspected. The two derivative signs are independently certified by rational interval arithmetic from the packaged verification script.
limitations: The counterexample is three-dimensional and concerns the first radial moment.
It does not classify body classes for which the section-to-global implication may remain valid.
Historical novelty retains a residual risk from unindexed later literature.

source_ids: Banach Center Publications 84 (2009), Open Problem Session, Problem 7
title: A right circular cone disproves the dual-volume affine-section implication
